name: Clarvity Custom Product Designer
author: Krishna Sagar

sections.description:
Clarvity Custom Product Designer adds a live design editor to WooCommerce product pages. Customers add text, photos, clipart and shapes to your product, see the price, and order. You get print-ready files at the real print size.

For customers

  • Front and back sides, product types (Round Neck, Polo…) and product colours.
  • 26 bundled fonts, curved text, outline, shadow and letter spacing.
  • Photo tools: background remover (plain backgrounds), crop, filters, brightness and contrast.
  • Clipart, QR codes, templates, undo/redo, snap guides and a low-resolution warning.
  • Save a design and share it by link, WhatsApp or email; My Account > Saved designs.
  • Team orders: one design, a list of names, numbers and sizes.
  • Brand kit for logged-in customers: logos, colours and fonts.
  • Realistic preview that follows the folds of the product photo.

For shop owners

  • Front/back prices and print methods (DTG, screen print, embroidery…) priced per side.
  • Variable products: link types and colours to variation attributes.
  • Locked “fill-in” templates (e.g. name and date only).
  • Print Studio on every order: PNG at 150/200/300 DPI, multi-page PDF and SVG.
  • Button text of your choice (“Customize your product”…).

Privacy

Uploaded images and designs are stored on your site to show and print orders. Shared designs can be opened by anyone with the link. Guest designs are deleted after 90 days without changes. A suggested privacy policy text is added under Settings > Privacy.

Source Code and Third-Party Resources

All plugin code is included unminified. Bundled libraries (minified builds of the published releases; source at the links):

  • Fabric.js 5.3.0 – MIT – https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js
  • jsPDF 2.5.2 – MIT – https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
  • qrcode-generator 1.4.4 – MIT – https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  • Fonts via Fontsource – SIL OFL 1.1 (24 fonts) and Apache 2.0 (Yellowtail, Satisfy) – https://github.com/fontsource/fontsource – see assets/fonts/LICENSES.txt
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Edit a product. In the General tab tick “Enable designer”, add a product type with a front (and optional back) mockup, the print area and the real print width.
  3. Optional: prices, print methods, colours, team orders and variation links on the same screen; button text, print resolution and clipart under WooCommerce > Product Designer.
  4. View the product and click the designer button.
sections.faq:
How do I get print files?

Open the order and click “Open Print Studio” on the customised item.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Choose the Type and Colour attributes on the product; their values must match your type and colour names. Other attributes, such as Size, appear inside the editor.

How do I make a “fill in your name” product?

As a shop manager, design it on the product page, select each text item and set “Customers can” to “only change the text”, lock the rest, and save it as a template. Then tick “Load automatically” and “Fill-in only” on the product.

What does the background remover handle?

Plain or single-colour backgrounds. It runs in the browser; busy photo backgrounds are not supported.

Does the plugin contact other websites?

No. All scripts and fonts are bundled. The “Share on WhatsApp” button is an ordinary link to wa.me that opens only when a shopper clicks it.
sections.changelog:
1.8.1

  • Fix: with Realistic preview on, designs could look faded on mockups with a white or solid background. Flat fabric now keeps full strength.
  • New name and prefixes for the WordPress.org directory; existing data is moved automatically.
  • Declares compatibility with WooCommerce order storage (HPOS) and cart/checkout blocks.
  • Privacy policy suggestion, uninstall clean-up and bundled font licences.

Full history: changelog.txt
